project.visitorDecision: Choose the right seasonal habitat care for wild cavity-nesting bees, or safely evaluate already owned commercial bee brood without inferring emergence from weather.
project.primaryAction: Select spring, summer, autumn or winter, report garden flowers, nesting material and bee brood type, then follow one stage-specific cautious next action.

claims.subject: other
claims.limitation: MSU management guidance provides seasonal habitat recommendations, not a local live nest census or universal emergence date.

claims.limitation: Modeled base-50 Fahrenheit accumulation and anomaly describe regional weather-grid heat, not actual blooming or bee emergence.

claims.subject: weather-context
claims.limitation: NWS forecast at ZIP statistical point is a time-limited planning signal, not direct measurement at the property or proof of species-specific safety.

decisionState.selectedIdField: month.value transformed by seasonFor(month), with selected regional ZIP/city separately identifying optional evidence
decisionState.sourceOfTruth: Existing leafcutter-bees original safe decision planner render(), with month, flowers, nest, path, brood-stage and independent NWS/USA-NPN source evidence.
decisionState.unavailableBehavior: Retain safe first-action and interpretive year journal, mark weather/thermal evidence unavailable, never infer a ship or release date, and clear old data when ZIP changes.

scenarios.input: Load in the current Michigan month with no ZIP lookup and wild-bee setting.
scenarios.expectedVisibleAnswer: Visible habitat-first answer and current seasonal nest chapter, with no verified real-time nest or climate claim.
scenarios.sourceAndSafety: Static editorial field note stays available without any forecast, while dynamic evidence says not checked.

scenarios.input: Select summer season after spring using a native button or the month selector.
scenarios.expectedVisibleAnswer: Month updates to July, illustration shows leaf provisioning, and the season-specific first next action changes.
scenarios.sourceAndSafety: No spring/summer release forecast is invented by choosing a future month.

scenarios.input: Choose spring → summer → spring using the seasonal native buttons.
scenarios.expectedVisibleAnswer: Original spring journal title, first action, month and aria-pressed state are restored.
scenarios.sourceAndSafety: The current-week NWS forecast is never recast as a forecast for a manually selected month.

scenarios.input: Disable JavaScript and open the canonical guide.
scenarios.expectedVisibleAnswer: Static habitat-first next action, autumn narrative as an editorial illustration and primary scientific source links remain in HTML.
scenarios.sourceAndSafety: No claim of live seasonal progression, insect occupancy, or downloaded weather without scripts.

scenarios.input: Block all map tiles and third-party map scripts.
scenarios.expectedVisibleAnswer: No map is part of this tool; the native season choice and ZIP-centroid text continue to work without a mapping service.
scenarios.sourceAndSafety: No implied map route or precise address; Census ZIP statistical point stays explicitly approximate.

scenarios.input: Switch to an unmapped ZIP or expire NWS/USA-NPN source responses.
scenarios.expectedVisibleAnswer: Prior heat totals clear, the first actionable garden advice remains and the evidence notebook states forecast/model unavailable.
scenarios.sourceAndSafety: No silent location fallback, no reusing old forecast for a different ZIP, no false flower or cocoon readiness.

scenarios.input: Choose managed cocoons in unknown stage and a month other than summer.
scenarios.expectedVisibleAnswer: Safe planner prioritizes identification and warns against re-refrigerating ready-to-emerge incubated bees.
scenarios.sourceAndSafety: Species-specific brooding instructions take precedence over GDD or 75°F seller planning windows.

scenarios.input: Block the externally hosted lead bee photo.
scenarios.expectedVisibleAnswer: The illustration and primary answer remain, with photo figure collapsed rather than a blank image column.
scenarios.sourceAndSafety: Missing imagery does not invent photographic evidence or obstruct scientific sources.

failures.no-js: Static meaningful habitat-first next action, complete source section and printed seasonal explanation stay usable without scripts.
failures.no-tiles: No visitor map is embedded in this bee field guide; text ZIP precision and source links survive an unavailable map provider.
failures.no-image: Remote Wikimedia photograph collapses to single-column readable answer on error; separate CSS educational diagram remains expressly schematic.
failures.stale-data: No forecast/heat clearance; status explains official source stale/unavailable, clears old ZIP evidence and conservatively advises checking real blooms and nests.

photos.disclosure: Photographed in Florida; leafcutter species not identified to species level, never used to prove Michigan garden activity.
